notes: Authenticated as masenf; the final listing reconciled 103 open PRs. All 72 non-drafts have current git measurements and current-head state: 58 live refreshes plus 14 unchanged green states carried under the incremental rule.
Git measurements and local merge-tree use main eb148601ed82023ac4e0d0733008be656399a70b; local merge-tree is authoritative for clean versus conflicting.
Every previously red, newly changed, newly opened, and workflow-gated PR was refreshed. All 28 red PRs have log-derived findings; gate propagation is separated from root failures.
The listing was re-scraped twice after collection began. #7052 was re-fetched after a mid-run push, #7065 after a timeline update, and newly opened #7423 was added before the run was frozen.

Scarce-time ordering prioritizes compact issue-backed fixes with tests, full green CI, clean merges, and few unresolved findings; broad work is intentionally lower even when technically waiting on a maintainer.
A maintainer interaction is a human MEMBER, OWNER, or COLLABORATOR review, issue comment, or inline reply, excluding the PR author and known bots.

Waiting on maintainer requires a clean local merge, SUCCESS with at least 60 GitHub Actions checks, zero unresolved review threads, and author activity newer than the last maintainer interaction; creation is the baseline when there has been no peer maintainer interaction.
For the requested no-open-issues rule, open issues means unresolved review threads; linked product issues do not disqualify a fixing PR.
audit_corrections: Separated formal human review from general maintainer interaction: #6116, #6853, #7036, #7056, and #7219 have maintainer comments but no human review, so never-human-reviewed changed from 35 to 40 while no-maintainer-interaction remains 35.
caveats: #7423 was newly opened during this run and still had 17 jobs in progress at the final state fetch; its replacement changelog check had passed, while one superseded cancelled changelog run remained in the raw check history.
#7065 retained one in-progress unit job alongside its CodSpeed failure at the final pass.
Latest PR commit timestamps are used as the push-time proxy because GitHub commit objects do not expose a separate pushed timestamp here.
Sparse partial check suites are not treated as full green CI even when their limited rollup says SUCCESS.
